question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the following sentence to fill in the blank.

Most of the land near the town is __barren__, but the efforts of the farmers have turned it ________.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"barren"** means land that is too poor to produce much or any vegetation; unproductive. (बंजर)

 
 
• **Example: **The desert was** barren,** with no signs of life anywhere.
 
 
 
• **"Fertile" **refers to land or soil that is capable of producing abundant vegetation or crops; productive. (उपजाऊ)
 
 
• **Example: **The** fertile** soil in the valley ensures a good harvest every year.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'barren' **is **'fertile'**.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Sterile** (निष्क्रिय): Incapable of producing offspring or vegetation.

 
 
• **Example:** The sterile landscape stretched out for miles.
 
 
 
• **Infertile** (बांझ): Unable to reproduce or produce crops.
 
 
• **Example: **The infertile land was difficult to cultivate.
 
 
 
• **Unfruitful** (अनुत्पादक): Not producing good results; not productive.
 
 
• **Example:** Their efforts to grow crops in the unfruitful soil were in vain.
 
 

3c:Tbc2,

The correct answer is: Option 3.<
